description: You don't always need a heavy-duty vacuum cleaner to handle all of your household messes, and Bissell's ready clean upright carpet cleaner is a great carpet cleaner for those situations. It's specially designed for quick and easy cleanup Jobs on carpets, area rugs and heavy traffic carpeted areas. Remarkably, the three-amp cleaner only weighs in at 12-pounds, so you'll have no trouble bringing it from room to room, especially with the large, easy-to-maneuver wheels. The retractable handle also helps with simplifying storage, along with the quick-release cord wrap. Its six row removable cross action brush loosens and removes even the most stubborn embedded dirt. The water tanks are easy to empty and to fill, with a removable nozzle. And with a 1/2 gallon tank Capacity, you'll be surprised at how much time you're saving with fewer trips to the sink and faster deep-cleaning results. Just because the job is small doesn't mean it doesn't deserve the best deep cleaning results, and with Bissell's ready clean upright carpet cleaner, you'll get exactly that.
